生成された動画：=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided character and environment references only to maintain visual continuity with the previous scene.

Keep the same main female character appearance, clothing, hairstyle, proportions, and overall cinematic design established by the references.

Keep the same companion appearance established in the previous scene.

Keep the same soldiers, mountain road, distant valley, and home-village environment.

The previous final frame establishes the starting situation and spatial layout.

IMPORTANT SPATIAL CONTINUITY:

The characters are currently on an elevated mountain road overlooking a very large valley.

The home village is FAR AWAY below them.

The village must remain distant and relatively small within the enormous mountain landscape.

Large columns of smoke rise from the distant valley.

=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Late-afternoon mountain atmosphere.

Natural human movement.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Strong sense of distance and environmental scale.

No background music.

No subtitles.

English dialogue.

Natural mountain wind, footsteps, clothing movement, distant environmental sounds, and echoes from the valley.

The scene is tense but restrained.

=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Continue naturally from the previous scene.

The main character slowly rises beside her companion.

The nearby soldiers cautiously increase their distance from her while continuing to watch her.

Then a deep sound echoes from somewhere far below in the valley.

Everyone turns toward the distant home village.

Along the long road leading upward from the valley, another group of soldiers can already be seen moving quickly away from the village.

Their unusual retreat changes the situation.

The soldiers near the main character eventually leave in the same direction.

She remains behind.

Looking toward the distant village, she suddenly remembers her father is still there.

She calls for him and immediately runs downhill toward her home while everyone else moves away from the valley.

=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — SOMETHING CHANGES

Begin from a new camera angle.

Do not recreate the exact close-up from the previous final frame.

Use a low cinematic angle from behind the main character.

Her companion remains in the foreground while she slowly rises to her feet.

She looks toward him one final time.

No dialogue.

Then she lifts her head.

Several soldiers remain farther away on the mountain road.

As she stands, the nearest soldier cautiously takes one step backward.

Another follows.

The group gradually creates more distance.

Their attention remains on her.

Nobody approaches.

The main character notices their reaction.

She turns slightly toward them.

For a brief moment, the scene becomes still.

Then—

BOOM.

A deep sound echoes from very far away across the valley.

Everyone reacts to the sound.

The main character turns toward the valley.

The soldiers turn as well.

Reveal the enormous distant landscape.

Far below them, the home village remains small within the valley.

Two enormous columns of dark smoke rise high into the sky.

Small areas of orange light are visible far below.

Another distant sound rolls through the mountains.

Then movement becomes visible along the long road coming upward from the valley.

CUT.

Shot 2 — THE RETREAT

Use a long-lens view down the mountain road.

Several distant figures are already moving quickly uphill from the direction of the village.

As they come closer, they become recognizable as another group of soldiers.

Their movement is hurried and disorganized.

They are leaving the valley.

Some repeatedly glance behind them toward the distant village.

Return to the main character.

She watches them approach.

The soldiers beside her also watch.

One of the approaching soldiers calls loudly:

"RUN!"

He continues uphill.

The others follow him.

The soldiers near the main character hesitate.

Then one turns and follows.

The others begin leaving as well.

Soon the road fills with soldiers moving uphill, away from the valley.

The main character remains where she is.

CUT.

Shot 3 — FATHER

Soldiers continue moving past her and away into the mountains.

She watches them leave.

Then she slowly turns back toward the distant valley.

Far below, her home village is still surrounded by smoke and orange light.

Hold on her face.

A sudden realization.

Her father is still there.

Quietly:

"Father..."

She looks toward the village.

Then louder:

"FATHER!"

She immediately begins running downhill.

Everyone else is moving away from the valley.

She moves in the opposite direction.

Follow her from behind as she runs down the mountain road.

Finish with a wide cinematic view:

soldiers moving uphill away from the valley,

the main character running alone downhill,

and the distant home village beneath the enormous columns of smoke.

She continues toward home.

CUT.、16:9
